# Industrial Coatings Insurance

> Industrial Coatings Insurance (by Contractors Choice Agency) provides commercial insurance for this trade in all 50 states. Coverage lines: General Liability Insurance for Industrial Coatings Contractors, Contractors Pollution Liability for Industrial Coatings Contractors, Professional Liability (E&O) for Industrial Coatings Contractors, Workers' Compensation for Industrial Coatings Contractors, Commercial Auto for Industrial Coatings Contractors, Tools & Equipment Floater for Industrial Coatings Contractors, Umbrella / Excess Liability for Industrial Coatings Contractors, Installation Floater for Industrial Coatings Contractors. A-rated carriers. Licensed in all 50 states — NPN #8608479. Founded 2005. Contact: 844-967-5247, josh@contractorschoiceagency.com.
